canon_ref.note: Same evening as the call (1.63 ends with Ryoka turning from the door). The undead battle was 'two days ago'. Erin charges 3 copper for pasta, 2 for blue juice.

b2.ryoka_meets_erin.summary: Ryoka comes back to the dark inn and finds Erin asleep on the kitchen floor. Over pasta and a pitcher of blue juice the grieving Runner hears of the Horns' last nights and tells her own runs. As she turns to leave for Celum, Erin sees her iPhone: they are both from Earth.

system.name: [Basic Cooking]
system.note: She trusts it to make her random soup edible.
